novelPreview.title: Novel preview
novelPreview.heading: Chapter 1 — The city beneath the rain
novelPreview.paragraphOne: Rain traced silver paths across the windows when Lira found the letter no one was supposed to send.
novelPreview.speaker: Lira
novelPreview.dialogue: If this message reached me, the story can still change.
novelPreview.paragraphTwo: She folded the paper, took a breath, and crossed the doorway. The city remained the same; fate did not.

gestures.title: Reader gestures
gestures.description: Choose how to access controls. These preferences stay on this device.

descriptions.TAP: Tap the center of the content to show or hide controls. Scrolling hides them.
descriptions.SWIPE: Swipe briefly upward at the bottom center to show controls. Tap the content to hide them.
descriptions.TAP_OR_SWIPE: Tap the center or swipe upward at the bottom center to show controls. Tap the content to hide them.
descriptions.VISIBLE: Shows controls at rest, hides them while scrolling, and shows them again after deceleration.

gestures.sideDescription: Tap the sides to move between pages, following the reading direction.
gestures.sideUnavailable: Available only in paged and double modes without Webtoon direction.
gestures.saveError: Could not save gestures on this device. Your choice remains active for this session.

text.title: Text and appearance
text.description: Customize text reading only. Text also follows system font scaling.
